Computer Duster Nausea...
I have done many inhalents, but this one is still pretty weird to me. I have a pretty good past of inhalents that I tried,, including butane, ether(automotive grade), nitrous, and thats pretty much it. I found out about duster online
and found it to look pretty cool from the experiances I read. I went to one of those 'Office' stores, and got a can. They are pretty damn expensive too. For me it was $6.99 for one can, and the guy at the register asked me a series of questions when I bought it, like 'what are you gonna use this for?', 'why not use non-aersol products?', and finally 'do you know that this is a highly abused substance?'. When I got home I was pretty anxious to try it. I decided to inhale it through the mouth. I put the little straw in my mouth and began to inhale. After a lungful I exhaled, then noticed the 'freeze' feeling, where I stop in like a trance. It feels like a combo of ether an butane. I thought this stuff was great. I tried two hits the next time around,, half way through the 2nd hit I was 'frozen' up, I felt really dizzy(in a good way), and began to feel a nausea feeling coming over me. 'who cares', I thought to myself,, this 3rd time around I took 3 hits, and it hit me hard. I felt totally gone, and in a dream-state. I took one last hit just to anaylze this 'nausea' feeling that I had. I felt soo sick when I took this last hit. This feeling can ruin all the fun that you had before, so if you do this stuff make sure you use it in moderation.
